newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sigma Alimentos started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sigma Alimentos started.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said it had started coverage of Mexico's Sigma Alimentos SA de CV with rating of attractive.

-- "Sigma Alimentos is an important link in Mexico's food chain, as the leading provider of low-cost, quality animal protein on a national scale," analysts Mark Abramson, Carlos Laboy and Hector Tassinari wrote in a report dated Tuesday.

-- "We set a 12-month price target of $11 (per local share), (up) about 20 percent from current levels, and rate Sigma Alimentos Attractive, noting the extremely low liquidity of shares and the lack of a near-term prospect for ADR (American Depositary Receipt) facilities."
-- They added, "We recommend investors take positions in Sigma as a core holding in any portfolio seeking exposure to the Mexican food sector."
